summary: R8 Games' futuristic anti-gravity racer, originally released on Windows as Formula Fusion and later rebranded as Pacer for its expanded console-era release.

entries.title: Pacer / Formula Fusion

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Pacer began as Formula Fusion on Windows in 2017, was rebranded as Pacer in 2019, and later released on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in 2020. Windows is the highest-fidelity and earliest full route for the Wipeout-inspired anti-gravity racer.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Pacer Windows PC release at the highest stable settings; use PS4/Xbox One as console alternatives.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release originally titled Formula Fusion and later rebranded as Pacer.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most direct route.

all_releases.fidelity: Console release under the Pacer name.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route and no sourced content advantage over Windows.

all_releases.fidelity: Console release under the Pacer name.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route and no sourced content advantage over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced console-exclusive content requires a secondary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Formula Fusion is the earlier title/release identity; Pacer is the later rebrand rather than a separate sequel.
